61/G.goal: Explain how Unity implements the rendering, physics, animation, and audio subsystems used to build an XR application.
61/G.achieves: It gives the learner foundational engine-level knowledge to connect XR concepts to practical implementation and build an XR system with confidence.

61/O1.goal: Describe how Unity's graphics-pipeline environment supports creating and displaying visual content for XR applications.
61/O1.achieves: It lets the learner choose and use Unity's render pipelines and graphics APIs to build the visual foundation of an XR system.

61/O2.goal: Explain how Unity's physics engine uses rigid bodies, colliders, joints, and articulation to simulate realistic motion and collision in XR scenes.
61/O2.achieves: It lets the learner add credible physical interaction to XR content when implementing an XR system.

61/O3.goal: Explain how Unity's animation and audio components support character animation and immersive sound in XR experiences.
61/O3.achieves: It lets the learner build the motion and sensory aspects of an immersive XR experience as part of a practical XR implementation.
